description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called DebugSettings, which provides a graphical interface for debugging and diagnostic tools within the OpenClaw application. It includes sections for gateway management, logs, port diagnostics, paths configuration, quick actions, canvas interactions, and experiments. The code handles user interactions, state management, and invoking various debug and diagnostic actions.

classes.name: PlainSettingsGroupBoxStyle
classes.description: A custom SwiftUI GroupBoxStyle that formats group boxes with a specific style for the debug settings panels.

methods.name: runPortCheck
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check of gateway ports to diagnose port issues.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel used for the gateway and reruns port diagnostics.

methods.name: requestKill
methods.description: Requests to kill a specific port listener process, prompting for confirmation if necessary.

methods.name: killConfirmed
methods.description: Confirms and executes killing a process by PID.

methods.name: chooseCatalogFile
methods.description: Opens a file dialog for selecting a models.generated.ts file and reloads models accordingly.

methods.name: reloadModels
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the model catalog file and updates state with the number of loaded models or an error.

methods.name: sendVoiceDebug
methods.description: Sends a debug voice message asynchronously and updates status based on success or failure.

methods.name: revealApp
methods.description: Reveals the application bundle in Finder.

methods.name: saveRelayRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root path for the gateway process.

methods.name: loadSessionStorePath
methods.description: Loads the session store path from configuration.

methods.name: saveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Saves the current session store path into configuration.

methods.name: canvasPresent
methods.description: Displays a directory in Canvas for debugging purposes.

methods.name: canvasWriteSamplePage
methods.description: Creates and writes a sample HTML page in Canvas for testing.

methods.name: canvasEval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the Canvas session.

methods.name: canvasSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the Canvas session and provides the file path.
